::: {#exr-function-between}

#### A function between the layers

Apply the [logistic function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-logistic-function) $\sigmoid$ to each of the 32 numbers between the two layers of @exr-two-linear,
computing `second(torch.sigmoid(first(x)))`.
Is the stack still an [affine function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-affine-function) of $\vx$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint
An [affine function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-affine-function) $f$ maps the midpoint of two inputs to the midpoint of their outputs:
$f\paren{\frac{1}{2}(\vx + \vx')} = \frac{1}{2}\paren{f(\vx) + f(\vx')}$.
Try two digits.
:::
